name: Sleep
summary: Counts the time your iPhone lies still and unused by your bed as sleep, reads and writes sleep through Apple Health, and shows your nights, bedtime, and sleep debt on the web and desktop, encrypted under your account's key.

screenshots.alt: Sleep page with last night's 7 h 20 min against an 8 hour goal, bedtime and wake time, and a 30-night sleep chart

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Sleep
config.description: How long you slept each night, worked out from your phone resting by your bed and from Apple Health.
